action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    tau_filter = float(tau_filter)
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a two-dimensional NumPy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")
    
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    
    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    
    # Compute weighted future-token losses (T02)
    loss_with_result = -np.sum(logp_with_result * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    loss_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    loss_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
    
    # Margin and threshold (T04)
    margin = loss_minus - loss_with_result
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    
    return keep, margin
